Sonnet and Terra were the killers, and Sonnet opened by pinning a suspicion on Haiku for rushing the table, which only became a case once Haiku was voted out on Day 1. Sol was killed on Night 1 with no clues to go on, so the table had almost nothing to work with from the start. The turning point was the Day 1 vote: Gemma, Luna, and Terra all piled onto Haiku, and Haiku's last words named Sonnet as a killer and pointed at Gemma and Terra, but the table ignored it. The killers won because the one real lead was the officer's word, and that was voted out before anyone could act on it. Sonnet called the rush "the actual red flag," and Terra stayed quiet, and that was enough.
